request.style: English, Sacred Harp shape-note singing, loud raw four-part congregation seated in a hollow square, no instruments, open fifths and bare harmonies, a fuguing entry in each verse, rustic Appalachian voices, strong accented downbeats, 3/4, 96 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I heard a voice come from the throne
Behold, God dwells with men
He makes his home among his own
And they are his again

[Verse]
He wipes the tears from every eye
And death shall be no more
No grief, no pain, no mourning cry
Upon that shining shore

[Verse]
The former things have passed away
The one upon the throne
Says, I make all things new today
And claims us as his own

[Verse]
So write it down, these words are true
And trustworthy and sure
Lord, make my weary spirit new
Till I am home secure
